issues.desc: background.md Trigger Event uses the token "B-impl" in parentheses ("The operator asked to build the capability (B-impl) starting now") which is not a valid Lattice story-ID format (B-xxxx). A new reader cannot tell whether this is a placeholder that was never replaced, an informal label, or a typo. Per Dimension 2, cross-story references need a one-sentence explanation on first appearance.

background.md Conversation Texture uses "full-3x2 review" without defining the term in the background itself ("genuine Claude+Codex full-3x2 review (the recurring program standard)"). A new reader cannot infer that this means 3 review rounds x 2 independent hosts without reading CLAUDE.md or the spec §4.1. The background must be standalone-readable.

background.md Conversation Texture references story B-0e7b ("The build must itself go through the full Lattice workflow with genuine Claude+Codex full-3x2 review") without a one-sentence explanation of what B-0e7b was. Per Dimension 2, cross-story references must have a one-line context on first appearance so the background is independently readable.
